params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zaahen''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Determination'' for each enemy {{tip|champion}} damaged by his {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}}, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking up to 12 times. After the duration, the stacks expire by {{pp|1;2;3;4;5|0 to 2 by 0.5|type=seconds elapsed|label=Stacks lost|formula=Loses 1 stack immediately, increasing by 1 every interval.|label1=Seconds}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
params.description2:
{{sbc|Determination:}} For each stack, '''Zaahen''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} equal to {{as|{{pp|1.5 + (2.8-1.5)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} AD}}. At maximum stacks, '''Zaahen''' becomes filled with ''Determination'', causing him to double the bonus to {{as|{{pp|1.5*12*2 + (2.8*12*2-1.5*12*2)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} AD}}.

Periodically, if '''Zaahen''' would take {{tip|death|lethal damage}} while at maximum stacks of ''Determination'', he refreshes its duration and enters {{tip|resurrection}} for 4 seconds: becoming {{tip|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. Additionally, he {{tt|restores|Not considered healing}}{{ft|{{as|{{pp|30 to 75 for|1;6;11;16|key=%}} of his '''maximum''' health}}|{{as|{{pp|30/(4/0.125) to 75/(4/0.125) for|1;6;11;16|key=%}} of his '''maximum''' health}} every {{fd|0.125}} seconds}}over the duration. Afterwards, he revives himself and refreshes the duration of ''Determination''.
params.customlabel: {{tt|Static Cooldown|Revive cooldown, unaffected by ability haste. Cooldown starts after the resurrection is complete.}}
params.notes: * The bonus attack damage granted by ''Determination'' stacks will update dynamically with '''Zaahen's''' total attack damage. * ''Determination'' stacks are generated per damage instance per champion damaged with '''Zaahen's''' attacks and abilities. ** ''{{ais|Q|Zaahen}}'' initial cast empowered attack can generate a stack for each strike. ** Both passes of ''{{ai|W|Zaahen}}'' can generate a stack. ** Both ''{{ais|E|Zaahen}}'' swing and ''{{ais|R|Zaahen}}'' shockwave generate a stack for every champion hit. ** {{cai|Triggerseed|Ivern}} generates a stack for every champion hit when cast on '''Zaahen'''.{{bug}} * During the resurrection's health restoration, '''Zaahen's''' {{sti|{{as|'''current''' health}}}} is set to a percentage of his {{as|'''maximum''' health}} equal to the cumulative amount of health restored on that restoration tick, for every single tick. ** In other words, his current health will always be overridden by the percentage of health he is supposed to have restored on every restoration tick, to prevent him from healing or restoring health by other sources. * Upon the resurrection being triggered, all [[summoner spell]]s that are not already on cooldown are placed on a 5-second {{sti|cooldown}}. * The {{tip|untargetability}} from the resurrection does not {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectiles}}. * ''Cultivation of War's'' resurrection takes priority over {{iis|Guardian Angel}} {{nie|Rebirth}}, but grants priority to {{cai|Chronoshift|Zilean}}. * The resurrection does not activate if '''Zaahen''' is killed by the {{tip|Nexus Obelisk}}. * {{tip|Invulnerable|Invulnerability}} will prevent stacks from being generated, as no damage is dealt. * {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent stacks from being generated, even if no damage is dealt.{{bug|1}} * ''Cultivation of War'' {{tip|stacks additively}} with {{bi|Infernal Might}} and {{iis|Overlord's Bloodmail}} {{nie|Retribution}} and {{tip|stacks multiplicatively|multiplicatively}} with [[Role Quests#Quests|mid lane quest's]] {{as|bonus AD}} multiplier. * ''Determination'' stacks are displayed in a secondary resource bar under '''Zaahen's''' [[health bar]]. ** The bar is '''white''' at <4 stacks, '''yellow''' at ≥4 stacks and '''orange''' at ≥9 stacks. *** At maximum stacks, if the revive is available, the bar will be '''red''' and will remain '''red''' after '''Zaahen''' revives until he loses stacks again.{{bug|2}} * There's a short delay between the stacks falling off and the removal of the revive. If '''Zaahen''' triggers it during this time, it will fail to go on cooldown.{{bug}} * The following table refers for interactions while '''Zaahen''' is locked out during the resurrection: {{ct|attack=false|move=false|cast=false|items=false|consume=false|spells=true,false,false,false,false,false,false|interrupts=death}}
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Zaahen}} {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} against enemy {{tip|champions}} grant him {{tip|stacks}} of ''Determination'', refreshing on subsequent damage to champions and stacking up to 12 times.
params.blurb2: Periodically, if '''Zaahen''' would take lethal damage while at maximum stacks of ''Determination'', he will enter {{tip|resurrection}} for a short time, {{tip|healing}} himself over the duration and then reviving himself.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Determination:}} For each stack, '''Zaahen''' gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, increased greatly while at maximum stacks.

description.plain: Innate: Zaahen generates a stack of Determination for each enemy champion damaged by his basic attacks and abilities, lasting for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking up to 12 times. After the duration, the stacks expire by 1 – 5 (based on seconds elapsed) every 0.5 seconds.

description2.plain: Determination: For each stack, Zaahen gains bonus attack damage equal to ⟦pp⟧ AD. At maximum stacks, Zaahen becomes filled with Determination, causing him to double the bonus to ⟦pp⟧ AD. Periodically, if Zaahen would take lethal damage while at maximum stacks of Determination, he refreshes its duration and enters resurrection for 4 seconds: becoming invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act. Additionally, he restores⟦pp⟧ of his maximum healthover the duration. Afterwards, he revives himself and refreshes the duration of Determination.

blurb.plain: Innate: Zaahen basic attacks and abilities against enemy champions grant him stacks of Determination, refreshing on subsequent damage to champions and stacking up to 12 times.

blurb2.plain: Periodically, if Zaahen would take lethal damage while at maximum stacks of Determination, he will enter resurrection for a short time, healing himself over the duration and then reviving himself.

blurb4.plain: Determination: For each stack, Zaahen gains bonus attack damage, increased greatly while at maximum stacks.

params.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Zaahen''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and gain {{as|{{sti|25 '''bonus''' range}}}}. {{tip|On-attack}}, he strikes the target twice. If the target was a champion, minion, or monster, he also {{tip|heal|heals}} himself. The strikes deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} and the heal is reduced to 50% against minions and monsters.

Each strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Zaahen|crit_base}}/2|50|base=50}}|critical damage}}|{{sti|{{as|50% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}}}{{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
params.leveling:
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|15 to 75}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20 to 40}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|15/2 to 75/2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100/2}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20/2 to 40/2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Champion Healing|{{as|{{ap|5 to 9}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}|Non-Champion Healing|{{as|{{ap|5*0.5 to 9*0.5}}% of his '''maximum''' health}}}}
params.description2: After {{fd|1.5}} seconds of using the empowered attack, ''The Darkin Glaive'' can be recast within the next 4 seconds at no additional cost, modifying it with a new effect.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Zaahen''' empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{as|{{sti|25 '''bonus''' range}}}}, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knock up}} the target for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
params.description5: ''Both casts of The Darkin Glaive {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} '''Zaahen's''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* ''The Darkin Glaive's'' damage is tagged as {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}, which allows it to trigger {{tip|spell effects}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the knock up from the recast.
* Since the healing is granted on-attack, parrying effects will not prevent '''Zaahen''' from gaining the heal. Otherwise, parrying effects will negate all other aspects of ''The Darkin Glaive's'' attacks while consuming them.
* The ability will not heal against wards, plants, or structures.
* Upon being put in resurrection and if ''The Darkin Glaive'' is active, it is placed on cooldown immediately.
* The first cast's double-strike attack: 
** Rolls {{tip|critical strike}} once for both strikes.
** Does not cause '''Zaahen''' to attack twice.
*** Effects that trigger on-attack or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with ''The Darkin Glaive''. (e.g. {{ri|Lethal Tempo}}, {{ri|Hail of Blades}}).
** Will consume {{ri|Bone Plating}} once.{{bug}}
*** If the first strike triggers the rune, the second one will get blocked by it.
*** If the first strike is blocked by the rune, the second one will not.
* The {{fd|1.5}}-second delay is '''not''' "fuzzy" (it will never take up to another {{fd|0.25}} seconds) and so will never correctly sync up with {{ii|Sheen}} like {{cai|Precision Protocol|Camille}}.{{bug|2}}
params.tips:
* Due to the critical strike rolling behavior affecting both of ''The Darkin Glaive's'' first cast's attacks with the same outcome, {{ii|Sundered Sky}} may synergize greatly with its effect when ready.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zaahen''' extends his glaive in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Upon reaching maximum range, all enemies hit are dealt {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|pulled}} 225 units toward '''Zaahen'''.
params.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block both passes, as well as the second one individually if circumstances permit.
* {{tip|projectile|Intercepting}} the initial projectile will instantly trigger ''Dreaded Return's'' pull. <!--Might only trigger when its destroyed?-->
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will '''not''' resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
* The damage, stun, and pull from hitting the target do not occur if '''Zaahen''' is {{tip|death|dead}} by the time the missile reaches maximum range.
* The projectile is shown on the minimap and ''Dreaded Return'' can be cast targeting the minimap.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''Dreaded Return'' maintains its casting angle direction in relation to '''Zaahen''' if he moves during the cast time.
* ''Dreaded Return'' briefly provides {{tip|sight|vision}} over an area.
** {{pending for test}} How big is the vision bubble and how long does it last?
<!-- Blurb -->
